name: jtag-vector
notes: Test-only program (test_ext): generic JTAG vector engine on TCK0/TDI1/TDO2/TMS3.

Each TX word carries 16 JTAG bits LSB first as (TMS, TDI) pairs: bit 2k = TMS, bit 2k+1 = TDI of JTAG bit k. TMS is set with OUT while TCK is low, then a one-bit fused XFER drives TDI, pulses TCK and samples TDO on the rising edge.
Each RX word returns the 16 TDO samples, bit k = TDO at the rising TCK edge of JTAG bit k. Any TAP state walk, IR scan or DR scan is a host-built vector sequence.
